customManagers.description: Track the pinned upstream Hindsight slim base image in Dockerfile.hindsight. A custom manager rather than the built-in Dockerfile manager because the tag lives in an ARG default, and because the `-slim` suffix needs its own versioning scheme — plain semver treats it as a prerelease and would never offer a bump.

packageRules.description: A base bump changes the runtime errand ships to every user, and the derived image's build-time self-test is the only thing standing between a bad base and a published image. Never group it with anything else, and label it so the reviewer knows to check the build log rather than just the diff.
